ValidationRule.description: AC6 (EHIS-3798): PHOCS BLA cannot be Closed without a Closure Reason. Scoped to the 5 PHOCS record types; ALR and Dairy excluded.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "ConstructionPermitApplication", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Evaluation", RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSExemptions", RecordType.DeveloperName = "OperatingPermitApplication", RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSRecordofSewerageSystem" ), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed"), ISPICKVAL(ClosureReason__c, '') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Provide Closure Reason before closing this application
